alignments.note: הָיָה → may be, headed on the lexical predicate (rule 24).
אוֹת → a sign; the indefinite article belongs to the noun (rule 15).
בְּקֶרֶב fused to the single among, headed on the construct noun carrying the lexeme (rules 23, 30).

כִּי rendered by the pair that when written contiguously at the clause's left edge; both words are one rendering of the single connective morpheme standing in the clause (rule 55). Competing reading: when as an added subordinator under rule 55's count.
מָחָר rendered by the phrase in time to come, headed on the content word the phrase turns on (rules 24, 31).
Interrogative מָה → What. The clause is verbless and the ASV's mean is a supplied lexical verb, not the construction's copula, so it stays outside this unit (rule 20).

mean is a whole lexical verb supplied for a clause whose Hebrew writes none: rule 20 supplies the copula and the presentative dummy from the construction and nothing more, and names a supplied lexical verb added under rule 30, as with were given and the done of violence done to the land. Competing reading: mean as the copula on the predicate מָה, following rule 20's What man is this — but that example writes is, and mean predicates meaning rather than identity; a third reading would give it to the לְ as rule 49's relational verb, which fails because the לְ already holds by and its own object is realized as the subject ye.
Suffix → ye, the subject pronoun of the recast clause (rules 18, 40).

לְ takes the by written in the recast clause; a present function morpheme takes an English function word before a supplied-word analysis does (rule 11). Competing reading: by as part of the supplied verb's valency, leaving the לְ unrepresented under rule 40.
Article on the noun: the phrase's single determiner is the demonstrative's (rule 41).

review_notes: Corrected: mean is now its own added unit and מָה keeps only What. Rule 20 limits the construction's supply to the copula and the presentative dummy and expressly makes a supplied lexical verb added; mean is a lexical verb, unlike the is of rule 20's What man is this.
Everything else in the accepted alignment is retained, including the that when pair on כִּי and the by on the לְ.
Partition after the correction: 22 source ids and 24 target ids each covered once.
